description: A colorful sticker activity sheet is open on the bed, showing two cartoon axolotls with a panel of unused sticker pieces on the right. The right hand pinches and peels up a small sticker piece from the right-side panel, briefly steadies it with the left hand as a two-hand object, then the right hand carries it leftward and presses it onto the small axolotl picture while the left hand holds the page flat and helps smooth the sticker down.
